ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) across approximately 90% of visible surface with high-intensity (off-white) clusters at the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation across central lobes; high-contrast contiguous circular blobs (barnacles) mapped to the distal tip of the left lobe and the superior margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible acute V-shaped depression at the lobal convergence; deep vertical notch relative to the visible horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency, moderate undulations with less physical disruption.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe outer edge exhibits a continuous convex curve; right lobe outer edge exhibits a convex curve heavily modified by surface protrusions and irregular edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) localized on the outer margins and tips of both lobes, indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-aligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the surface of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jagged irregularities and apparent trauma-induced serrations on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense localized barnacle colonization on the upper right lobe margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical distribution of white rosette clusters, with higher density and larger contiguous grouping on the superior edge of the right lobe compared to the left.
